DIAGNOSIS READY: Boerhaave Syndrome (Esophageal Rupture)

The clinical picture of forceful vomiting following heavy alcohol consumption, followed by sudden chest pain and coughing, is classic for esophageal rupture. Given the severity of your symptoms and the inability to communicate, I am requesting an immediate CT scan of the chest with contrast to confirm the diagnosis.
